propositions: Read-only derivations must compute agent-process metrics (attempts_per_ticket, first_pass_rate, rework_within_days, reopen_recovery, revert_recovery) over the durable ticket event store including compaction-retired events.

Metrics requiring per-event or multi-occurrence data (attempts, rework windows, reopen counts) must read raw event files sorted by event_sort_key with retired events included; metrics needing only a terminal value (first_pass_rate, revert_recovery) must read compiled state from reduce_ticket.

attempts_per_ticket counts distinct claim sessions from open→in_progress STATUS edges; first_pass_rate measures closed tickets never reopened (absent last_reopened_at); rework_within_days counts closed→open→closed sequences within n days; reopen_recovery counts tickets with ≥1 closed→open edge; revert_recovery counts tickets with substantive reverts (target_event_type STATUS or COMMITS).
An empty date range yields None (→ Unavailable); a populated range with zero qualifying events returns 0 (measured zero).
All metrics register with source='structural' and confidence='high'; revert_recovery must filter by target_event_type to exclude COMMENT-only reverts and prove the filter logic via unit tests.
